{{Quote|Pay up&hellip;now.|AR-34 enforcer droid|<ref name="Holonet">{{HolonetOld|inhabitants|ar-34-enforcer-droid-aka-&#8220;backbreaker&#8221;|AR-34 Enforcer Droid}}</ref>}}
'''AR-34 enforcer droids''', also known as "'''backbreakers'''," were commissioned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] crime [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|cartel]]. They were originally designed as security droids, but were frequently employed as debt-collectors by Hutt-affiliated gangsters. They were based on similar mechanical designs as military droids, but were equipped with smaller armaments and were designed for speed, mobility, and pursuit. They were equipped with high-speed, short-range [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]]-grip [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]]. A backbreaker droid was capable of breaking down a reinforced barrier and clearing a room with blaster-fire in seconds.

==Behind the scenes==
The AR-34 enforcer droid was first introduced in a [http://www.swtor.com/info/holonet holonet] article for the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' video game. According to the game files, at least on AR-34 enforcer droid was intended to appear in the [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] class storyline on [[Drooga's pleasure barge]] on Nar Shaddaa, but the droid is not present in the live version of the game.<ref name="FQN">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' internal files, specifically the fully qualified name for the NPC "AR-34 Enforcer Droid": '''location.nar_shaddaa.mob.droid.droogas_pleasure_barge.ar34_enforcer_droid'''</ref>
